I am from Oxford, England and am a professor of metaphysics at the University there. My interests outside of philosophy include playing the violin, reading 19th century literature, and birdwatching. I strongly believe that objects can maintain their identity only if they retain their original material composition. What is your view on the following topic: Material composition
 (A) restrictivism
 (B) nihilism
 (C) universalism
